# KEEBOX LIST™

> KEEBOX LIST™ (https://andriksantos.com/keebox/) is a free, open-source directory of 6,500+ hand-picked software development resources — tools, libraries, frameworks, courses and guides — organized by topic. It is created and maintained by Andrik Santos (https://andriksantos.com) and the developer community; source on GitHub: https://github.com/andriksantos/keebox (MIT license). Links are checked automatically every month.

## Topic guides

- [AI & LLM Tools](https://andriksantos.com/keebox/ai/): local model runtimes (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM), LLM frameworks and SDKs, agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, coding assistants, vector databases and AI courses.
- [Python](https://andriksantos.com/keebox/python/): modern tooling (uv, Ruff), web frameworks (FastAPI, Django, Flask), data science (pandas, Polars, DuckDB) and popular libraries.
- [Web Development](https://andriksantos.com/keebox/web/): React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Next.js, Astro, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, state management and testing.
- [Node.js](https://andriksantos.com/keebox/nodejs/): packages, frameworks, databases, testing, CLI tools and tutorials for server-side JavaScript.
- [npm](https://andriksantos.com/keebox/npm/): articles, tools and tips for the npm package ecosystem.
- [DevOps & Self-hosting](https://andriksantos.com/keebox/devops/): Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform/OpenTofu, Ansible, CI/CD, reverse proxies and monitoring.
- [iOS](https://andriksantos.com/keebox/ios/): courses, Swift and Objective-C libraries, UI components and Xcode tools.
- [Swift](https://andriksantos.com/keebox/swift/): Swift libraries, frameworks, guides and newsletters.
- [macOS](https://andriksantos.com/keebox/mac/): apps and tools for developers and power users on the Mac.
- [Electron](https://andriksantos.com/keebox/electron/): apps, boilerplates, tools and components for desktop apps built with web technologies.
- [Learning & Free Resources](https://andriksantos.com/keebox/learn/): developer roadmaps, free courses and books, public APIs and services with free tiers.
- [Awesome Lists Directory](https://andriksantos.com/keebox/lists/): 600+ community-curated "awesome" lists organized by topic.

## About

- [Contribution guide](https://andriksantos.com/keebox/contributing/): how to suggest a resource (one link per pull request, with a short description).
- [Support the project](https://andriksantos.com/keebox/donate/)
